acceptanceCriteria: GOOS=freebsd, openbsd, netbsd and solaris go vet ./... passes, or each failing package carries an explicit build constraint that excludes the platform.
The darwin, linux and windows builds are unchanged.
body: On main 4c607266, go vet for GOOS=freebsd, openbsd, netbsd and solaris fails in three places. internal/cem/publish/read_other.go is tagged //go:build windows while read_unix.go is darwin || linux, so no read file builds on other platforms. internal/analyzerswift/command.go:40 calls readDescriptor, which only descriptor_posix.go (darwin || linux) and descriptor_windows.go define. experimental/analyzers/sqlnative/analyzer_test.go:797 calls ReadNoFollow, which only read_unix.go and read_windows.go define. These are not 1.0 platforms (PRS-V1-004), so this does not block rc.1. Fix: give each package a fallback that refuses on other platforms, matching the lock_other.go and secure_other.go pattern, or constrain the callers.
title: Packages fail to build on freebsd, openbsd, netbsd and solaris
